name: Emergence of Classes: the low demand and the way to equity (Poza et al.)
description: Poza et al. 2011's Fig. 7: the transition time from a fractious start against the low demand L (H = 100 − L), with 10 and 20 agents, m = 10, ε = 0.1. They report that a higher L slows the way to equity. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-25): with 10 agents 39, 86, 150, 168, 150 and 465 periods at L = 5, 15, 25, 30, 35, 45; with 20 agents 105, 111, 152, 161, 166 and 33 600 (one run capped). A higher L slows it, sharply near 45.
